title: Shared invoice puts the freelancer's login email in the link preview
description: The anonymous invoice page sets og:title and twitter:title to the branding name, which for a profile with no brand_name falls back through loadUserBrandDefaults (src/lib/proposals/brand.ts:170, full_name_ar → name → email) to the account's auth address. Pasting the invoice link into WhatsApp or Slack therefore shows the freelancer's private login address to everyone in the conversation, before anyone opens it. Distinct from RZQ-0004, which is the same address rendered in the page body: this one travels without a click and cannot be taken back. brand.test.ts asserts the email fallback is safe because 'it is not an address handed to the client' — verified false: invoices/artifact.ts:137 uses it as brandName, and the share page renders it.
evidence: fetched anonymously from /ar/i/Eu3QyLcYdfL6hXORvh6viOR_ with no session
users.brand_name and users.contact_email are both null for this account

title: Invoice totals are shown with the halalas dropped beside the document that keeps them
description: An invoice of 9,938.21 SAR is announced as ٩٬٩٣٨ ريال in two places while the artifact directly below/behind it prints ٩٬٩٣٨٫٢١. (a) the invoice header summary strip renders AnimatedNumber, which formats with maximumFractionDigits: 0 (components/tool/AnimatedNumber.tsx:21); (b) the shared invoice's meta description does Math.round(total_sar) (invoices share page). (b) is client-facing: the link preview states a total 0.21 SAR below what is owed. Same view, two totals.
evidence: header strip and og/meta description both read ٩٬٩٣٨ ريال

title: Invoice builder prints the VAT rate in Latin digits beside the same rate in Arabic-Indic
description: With VAT switched on, the totals panel line reads 'ضريبة القيمة المضافة (15%)' while the toggle above it in the same view reads 'ضريبة القيمة المضافة (١٥%)' — the banned mixed-numeral class that passes 3, 4 and 6 each closed elsewhere. The interpolation is raw (InvoiceForm.tsx:516, `{t("vatLabel")} ({vatPct}%)`), so the number never reaches a formatter. Worth more than its severity: /ar/invoices/new is already in the numeral sweep's route list and the sweep does not see this, because the line only renders once VAT is on — which needs a VAT-registered profile, which a swept account never has. The guard has a blind spot shaped like every state that takes work to reach.
evidence: toggle label in the same view: ضريبة القيمة المضافة (١٥%)

note: print:hidden header chrome, not a dropped figure
Latin digits came from the run own generated item name

title: Saving a client does not navigate to the created client
description: Submitted and stayed at http://localhost:3000/ar/clients/new; a save that appears to do nothing invites a second submit.

note: freelancerName no longer falls back to any email (loader) + ownName scrub at render; poisoned stored invoice now renders مستقل, zero addresses on the anonymous page.
Same root cause: og:title/twitter:title on /ar/i/[token] now read فاتورة رِزق for a nameless freelancer; real brand name (زهراني) still shown.

Does not reproduce: under quota the row saves and the browser lands on /ar/income (19->20, url /ar/income). At the 20/month free ceiling nothing saves (20->20), the form keeps its values, and a visible dialog says لقد بلغت حدّك الشهري للمشاريع. The sweep asserted only the URL, so a working paywall read as a defect on every free-exhausted row.

Does not reproduce: with a quota slot free the row saves and the browser navigates to /ar/clients/{id} (9->10, sampled every 700ms — the push is not undone by the actions revalidatePath). At the 10-client free ceiling nothing saves (10->10), it stays on /ar/clients/new and a dialog explains why. Same URL-only sweep assertion as RZQ-0010.

Latin stacks (--font-sans/--font-mono/--font-heading) now end in Tajawal, so an Arabic glyph inside a Latin-styled element falls back to a declared face instead of whatever the device has. /ar/dashboard reports clean under the sweeps own predicate; Latin still leads with Space Grotesk.
Same root cause as RZQ-0001. /ar/income went from 6 flagged strings to clean; the anonymous invoice page /ar/i/[token] is clean too.

title: Opacity-modified text tokens fail AA on income, calendar and settings
description: text-rizq-ink-soft/60 cannot reach 4.5:1 on any light surface: /ar/income shows 21 failing nodes, all of them the delivery date and status caption on every gig card. /ar/calendar has 5 (a /50 overflow count and three filter chips), /ar/settings 1 (حذف الحساب). Same class as RZQ-0002, which was filed for /ar/dashboard alone because that is the only route the sweep ran axe against. The design system already has --content-faint for exactly this, darkened to clear AA; the opacity modifier bypasses it.
